verdict.rationale: Installing a local LLM desktop app and runtime through a package manager (e.g., Homebrew, winget, apt, npm) is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions any package-manager distribution. The only install-related item, jan-gh-7, describes a build-from-source script that installs dependencies and launches the app, which is not a standard package-manager install.
